source.preference: DNG, then HEIC, then JPEG when the same shot exists in several formats.
source.orderRule: Backs were photographed flipped top-to-bottom, so their left-to-right order matches the fronts.
source.cropRule: Each painting is cropped to its painted area and perspective-corrected; nothing is padded. Group masters place the crops side by side (or stacked) on white, scaled down to the smallest member, never enlarged. The ridge strips are rotated 90° clockwise per the artist.
source.privacy: Back photographs and stamp text are never published.
